rules.statement: Under a decree against a special representative appointed under section 642 of the Civil Procedure Code, only the mortgaged property could be sold, and the sale of other than mortgaged property is invalid as against the heirs of the deceased mortgagor.
rules.supporting_quote: Only the mortgaged property could be sold, and the sale of other than mortgaged property is invalid as against the heirs of the deceased mortgagor.
